title: Guitar session: Kahn, Ron Tototz, and friends — the wide frame
description: The widest of the three guitar-session frames (with VN-0003 and VN-0007). The soldier in fatigues, a holstered pistol on his hip, leans against the screen door of the matting-walled hooch; the guitarist plays on a folding chair; the man in the pale blue sport shirt leans on his knee beside him; and Kahn, in sunglasses, white T-shirt and dark trousers, stands at right. A gravel yard with plank walkways runs up to the door, with sandbag revetments and a large green-walled screened tent behind. "People are the same as VN-0003 with Kahn on the right."
researchNotes: Larry's comment of 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0008-c18415632.json), with 'Location: Ton Son Nhut'. He refers the frame to VN-0003 rather than naming each man, so Ron Tototz is linked on that cross-reference (in VN-0003 the man to Kahn's left); only Kahn is placed in this frame by position. Of the three frames this one shows the most of the camp — the screen-door hooch, plank walkways over gravel, the sandbag revetment and the screened tents — and is the best of them for matching the camp against other photographs.
